stepExplanation:
Converting charge: q = 5 μC = 5 × 10⁻⁶ C

Force magnitude:
$$F = qE = (5 \times 10^{-6})(2000) = 0.01 \text{ N} = 10 \text{ mN}$$

Direction: Since the charge is negative, it experiences a force opposite to the electric field direction - toward the positive plate.
stepBody: Calculate F = qE using q = 5 μC and E = 2000 N/C. Give the magnitude in N and state which plate the sphere moves toward.
